info.name: Wallet Snapshot Aggregate API - majdpay (dev)
info.description:
EMI-6124 (BE - Aggregate the Complete Wallet Snapshot Logic): end-to-end verification of WalletSnapshotFacade.start(cutoff), the composition root over EMI-6116-6123/6126. See docs/business-knowledge/EMI-6124-Refined-Ticket.md and docs/business-knowledge/Wallet-Snapshot-Pipeline-Architecture.md.

This is NOT a collection of new endpoints - EMI-6124 has none of its own. It chains EMI-6115's trigger endpoint (folder 1, internal-only host, no auth) with EMI-6127's read endpoint (folder 2, public gateway, bearer token) specifically to exercise composition and cross-wallet consistency - the two things only observable across a full run, not from any single sub-ticket's own endpoint in isolation.

AUTH: no auth is set at the collection level (matching folder 1's real contract - see WalletSnapshotJob-API-majdpay.postman_collection.json for why). Folder 2's requests set a real bearer token explicitly, per-request only, never inherited - the same lesson learned the hard way while debugging a duplicate-Authorization-header 500 in WalletSnapshotAdmin-API earlier in this epic.

CAUTION: folder 1 mutates real data (runs an actual snapshot job). Never run this collection unattended/in CI.

item.name: 1. Trigger a run covering mixed wallet states
1. POST trigger the snapshot job - CAUTION: real mutating job

request.description: CAUTION - mutates real data. Before sending, set {{walletA}}/{{walletB}} to wallets you have arranged to cover the mixed states WAG-01 needs (normal, provisional-opening, no-running-balance-zero-ledger, no-running-balance-non-zero-ledger/DRIFT), and a matched pair for WAG-02's consistency check.

item.name: 2. WAG-01 - Read back and confirm composed rules (needs adminToken)
1. GET snapshots for the cutoff date - inspect each wallet's composed fields

request.description: {{adminToken}} is set on THIS request only - never at the collection level, so folder 1's unauthenticated trigger never accidentally inherits it. Inspect the response manually for WAG-01: confirm each fixture wallet shows the expected status/provisionalOpening/flags combination for its intended state.

exec: pm.test('at least one snapshot row exists for this cutoff', () => pm.expect((b.content || []).length).to.be.greaterThan(0));
console.log('Snapshot rows for WAG-01 manual inspection:', JSON.stringify(b.content, null, 2));

item.name: 1. GET wallet A's snapshot - captures its computed fields

request.description: {{walletA}} and {{walletB}} must be two wallets with structurally identical ledger histories (same amounts, same transaction types) for this comparison to be meaningful.

exec: pm.test('a snapshot row exists for walletA', () => pm.expect(row).to.not.be.undefined);

item.name: 2. GET wallet B's snapshot - compares against wallet A's captured fields

request.description: Run request 1 (wallet A) immediately before this one in the same run - Postman's collection variables persist across requests in a single run.

exec: pm.test('a snapshot row exists for walletB', () => pm.expect(row).to.not.be.undefined);
